title: Allow slow macOS Chrome CDP cold starts without false browser-unavailable failures.
changes: Give a newly auto-launched macOS Chrome up to 12 seconds to expose its loopback CDP endpoint; Linux and Windows keep the existing 5-second budget.
Keep read-only browser tools non-launching and preserve loopback-only CDP, URL/SSRF checks, exact-target validation and session isolation.
Add deterministic startup-budget and target-liveness tests plus an owner-only repro harness.
Verify on real Apple Silicon: clean cold starts succeeded below 0.7 seconds in 28/30 runs; the two rejected runs needed 5.46 and 9.17 seconds, confirming the old 5-second budget was the failure.
Ship the public client/runtime release before any private server merge; no production migration or permission change.
